text.p: AlphaNet Solutions Inc said Wednesday it consummated its acquisition of the assets and business of Lande Group Inc, a New York City based company.

AlphaNet purchased their customer list, accounts receivable, inventories and fixed assets for up to $1.0 million, of which $750,000 was paid at closing and the balance is held in escrow pending certain post-closing adjustments.
The company also assumed liabilities totaling about $4.8 million and obligations through 2008 under a lease for New York City office space which will serve as its New York office.
The company said the value of the assets purchased is about the same as the liabilities assumed.
The company said the acquisition was funded with a portion of the net proceeds of its recent follow-on offering.
